description: Electric utility income-statement skeleton for SIC 4911 retaining all 112 supplied US GAAP concepts once. The supplied Duke Energy reference guides broad presentation. Regulated-operation expense scopes, AFUDC components and borrowing-cost capitalization remain distinct; no arithmetic follows from hierarchy.
classification_notes: The 112-concept industry inventory covers multiple issuers; Duke Energy is a presentation reference, not evidence that every supplied concept is reported by Duke Energy.

The reference presentation guides broad revenue, operating result, financing, pretax result, attribution and EPS sections. No unsupported EBITDA, EBIT, unusual-item subtotal or tax breakdown is created.

Regulated operating expenses are not necessarily entity-wide expense. Cost of sales and operating-expense aggregates differ in production and SG&A coverage; detail and aggregate alternatives are not additive.
Fuel, purchased power, maintenance, production/nonproduction depreciation, taxes, accretion and share compensation may already be contained in functional or reported expense aggregates.

AFUDC total earnings additions include equity and/or borrowed-fund costs; the equity component is a subset. Total incurred and capitalized interest are supplementary reconciliation measures, not extra income-statement expense.
Operating net interest is explicitly distinct from nonoperating net interest. Interest instrument/maturity views without activity restriction remain separate pending issuer presentation.

Gains, impairments and acquisition/litigation costs may already be in operating or nonoperating aggregates; candidate group membership does not establish exceptional status or an additional earnings line.

Consolidated versus parent/NCI attribution, pretax with/without equity earnings, and domestic geographic components remain separate scopes. Preferred dividends and participating-security allocation are distinct EPS adjustments.
Discontinued EPS for day-to-day operations only differs from EPS including disposal. Weighted-average shares and dilution adjustments are not additive denominators.
All concepts have aggregation_policy none at their nodes. Groups carry shared cautions; review concepts carry individual reasons. Missing facts are not zero and expense signs follow source facts.

metadata_contract.period_type: All 112 supplied concepts are duration according to official US GAAP 2026.
metadata_contract.unit_type: 100 monetary, 8 per-share and 4 shares concepts verified against the official schema. Currency and scale follow source facts.
metadata_contract.contra: All false: period expense, income, attribution and EPS adjustments are not balance-sheet contra accounts. No automatic sign inversion.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 112 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 4911.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

nodes.label: Reported revenue views
nodes.classification_note: Broad revenue, operating revenue and customer-contract revenue differ in activity and tax scope. Regulated and unregulated components may reconcile to total operating revenue only with matched issuer scope; no automatic sum.

children.label: Revenue total alternatives
children.classification_note: Revenues can include nonoperating earning activities whereas regulated/unregulated operating revenue concerns operating activities only.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Revenues
concepts.review_reason: Revenue includes earning activities beyond customer contracts and may include investment or interest income; it is not automatically identical to total utility operating revenue.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue
concepts.review_reason: Total regulated and unregulated operating revenue can contain the separate regulated/unregulated amounts and may differ from broader Revenues.

children.label: Operating revenue components
children.classification_note: Regulated and unregulated revenues can be components of the reported total operating revenue; do not add them to that total.

children.label: Customer contract revenue alternatives
children.classification_note: Including-tax and excluding-tax revenue are measurement alternatives and can be subsets of total revenue.

children.label: Revenue from contract with customer excluding assessed tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Customer-contract revenue excluding assessed taxes can be a subset of total utility revenue and differs from the including-tax customer-contract alternative.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Including-tax customer-contract revenue differs from the excluding-tax alternative and may still be only part of total utility revenue.

nodes.label: Operating expense and cost views
nodes.classification_note: Reported aggregates and natural/functional details overlap. Utility-specific costs cover regulated operations where defined. The reference presentation gross-profit presentation does not establish which taxonomy costs belong in COGS versus operating expense.

children.label: Reported expense aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: CostsAndExpenses includes cost of sales and operating expense; regulated utility expense is a regulated-only scope. OperatingExpenses excludes cost of sales but includes SG&A; OperatingCostsAndExpenses excludes both cost of sales and SG&A.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpense
concepts.review_reason: UtilitiesOperatingExpense covers regulated operations only and can contain fuel, purchased power, maintenance, D&A and taxes; it is not necessarily entity-wide total operating costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingExpenses
concepts.review_reason: OperatingExpenses excludes production costs in cost of sales and includes SG&A; it is not the same scope as total utility operating expense or CostsAndExpenses.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingCostsAndExpenses
concepts.review_reason: OperatingCostsAndExpenses excludes both production cost in cost of sales and SG&A; do not equate it with OperatingExpenses or the inclusive utility expense total.

children.label: Reported cost of sales alternatives
children.classification_note: Inclusive cost of sales/revenue and cost excluding DD&A are overlapping alternatives. Do not add production depreciation to a cost figure that already includes it.

children.label: Cost of goods and services sold

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold
concepts.review_reason: Cost of goods/services sold excludes financial-services and other revenue-generating costs under its definition; reconcile scope against CostOfRevenue before treating them as equivalents.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfRevenue
concepts.review_reason: CostOfRevenue may have broader revenue-activity coverage than CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold; use the reported cost measure rather than adding the two aggregates.

children.label: Cost of goods services excluding DD&A

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDepreciationDepletionAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: This cost-of-goods/services measure excludes DD&A and is an alternative to inclusive cost measures, not an additional expense alongside them.

children.label: Fuel and purchased power
children.classification_note: Fuel for all production/service activities differs from regulated fuel used. Purchased power is a distinct regulated expense but can be included in broader utility totals; confirm issuer exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FuelCosts
concepts.review_reason: Fuel costs relate to production and services generally and can include the regulated fuel-used expense; regulated and all-activity scope are not interchangeable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseFuelUsed
concepts.review_reason: Fuel used is expense of regulated operations only and can already be included in general fuel costs and total regulated utility operating expense.

children.label: Operations maintenance and administration
children.classification_note: Broad utility maintenance/operations/other includes SG&A, while routine utility maintenance/operations is narrower. SG&A contains general/administrative cost; these are overlapping functional classifications.

children.label: Utility operations maintenance and other costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMaintenanceOperationsAndOtherCostsAndExpenses
concepts.review_reason: This utility operations/maintenance-and-other-cost measure includes SG&A, unlike OperatingCostsAndExpenses which excludes SG&A.

children.label: Utilities operating expense maintenance and operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMaintenanceAndOperations
concepts.review_reason: Routine regulated plant maintenance, repairs and operations can be included in the broader maintenance/operations-and-other-cost measure, which includes SG&A.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
concepts.review_reason: SG&A includes narrower general/administrative expense and may be included in maintenance/operations-and-other utility costs; avoid duplicate functional expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
concepts.review_reason: General/administrative expense is contained in SG&A where reported and may already be within utility maintenance/operations-and-other costs.

children.label: Asset consumption expense views
children.classification_note: Total DD&A, utility D&A, production D&A, nonproduction D&A, all depreciation and nonproduction depreciation differ in scope. Select matching aggregate or component population; no automatic addition.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Total DD&A includes production and nonproduction consumption and depletion, unlike narrower utility, production-only and nonproduction measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Utility depreciation/amortization is restricted to regulated operations and can be included in the broader total DD&A or production D&A measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Production D&A is directly attributable to goods/services and can overlap utility D&A or total DD&A, unlike the nonproduction D&A definition.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Despite its broad name, the official definition concerns nonproduction physical-asset consumption and intangible amortization; do not treat it as total production DD&A.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Depreciation
concepts.review_reason: Depreciation includes production and nonproduction tangible assets and is contained in broader DD&A measures; it excludes intangible amortization.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationNonproduction
concepts.review_reason: Nonproduction depreciation is a subset of all depreciation and can already be included in the nonproduction D&A measure.

children.label: Nonincome tax expense views
children.classification_note: Utility non-income taxes, taxes excluding income and excise, and taxes classified as other have different scopes; none is corporate income tax expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UtilitiesOperatingExpenseTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Regulated utility tax expense excludes income taxes but does not have the same excise-tax exclusion as TaxesExcludingIncomeAndExciseTaxes.

children.label: Taxes excluding income and excise taxes

concepts.name: us-gaap:TaxesExcludingIncomeAndExciseTaxes
concepts.review_reason: This tax expense excludes both income and excise taxes, unlike regulated utility taxes that exclude income taxes only.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TaxesOther
concepts.review_reason: Taxes classified as other have unspecified tax coverage and cannot be assumed to equal all taxes other than income or all non-income/non-excise taxes.

children.label: Retirement accretion expense views
children.classification_note: Broad accretion includes ARO and potentially environmental/other contingencies; ARO accretion is a contained view and is not depreciation or cash settlement.

children.label: Accretion expense including asset retirement obligations

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccretionExpenseIncludingAssetRetirementObligations
concepts.review_reason: Accretion including ARO can also include environmental remediation and other contingencies; it contains narrower ARO accretion where reported.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationAccretionExpense
concepts.review_reason: ARO accretion reflects passage of time on the retirement liability and can be contained in the broader accretion-including-ARO expense.

children.label: Other natural and functional costs
children.classification_note: Share compensation, lease cost and research may already be in functional utility or administrative expenses. Other operating costs are issuer residuals, not automatically disjoint.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Allocated share-based compensation excludes capitalized awards and may already be included in operations, maintenance or administrative expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseCost
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease cost is a single lease expense that can be included in maintenance/operations or administrative expenses; it is not the lease cash payment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherCostAndExpenseOperating
concepts.review_reason: Other operating costs can contain separately disclosed natural expenses; distinguish the issuer residual from broader operating expense aggregates.

children.label: Other operating income views
children.classification_note: Other operating income is income-only while other operating income/expense is net; neither should be blindly added to the other.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet
concepts.review_reason: Other operating income/expense is a net residual and can include the income-only other operating amount; do not combine both views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other operating income is income-only and can already be included in net other operating income/expense.

nodes.label: Nonoperating income and financing
nodes.classification_note: Nonoperating aggregates contain narrower earnings lines. Net operating interest is kept outside this group. AFUDC equity income and debt capitalized interest preserve their separate financing roles.

children.label: Reported nonoperating aggregate
children.classification_note: The reported nonoperating total can include interest, investments, equity earnings, AFUDC and residuals represented below; hierarchy does not imply a rollup.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NonoperatingIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Total nonoperating income/expense can already include interest, equity earnings, AFUDC and residual items; select aggregate or matched components.

children.label: Nonoperating residual views
children.classification_note: Net other nonoperating income/expense can contain income-only and expense-only residuals; select one consistent residual scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating income/expense is a net residual that can contain the separate income-only and expense-only residuals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating income is an income-only residual and is not interchangeable with net other nonoperating income/expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating expense is an expense-only residual and can be included in net other nonoperating income/expense.

children.label: Nonoperating interest expense views
children.classification_note: Interest-and-debt expense can include financing charges beyond interest; nonoperating interest expense is a narrower view. Maturity/instrument detail remains in a separate all-classification group.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense
concepts.review_reason: Nonoperating interest-and-debt expense can include debt-related financing costs beyond interest and overlaps narrower interest expense measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseNonoperating
concepts.review_reason: Nonoperating interest expense is narrower than all-classification interest expense and can overlap interest-and-debt expense.

children.label: Nonoperating net interest and investment income
children.classification_note: Net nonoperating interest overlaps gross interest measures; investment income net includes dividends, discount/premium adjustments and investment expense, whereas investment interest is before those adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNonoperatingNet
concepts.review_reason: Nonoperating net interest is distinct from the operating net interest concept and may already include separately supplied gross interest income and expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNet
concepts.review_reason: Net investment income includes interest and dividends after premium/discount accretion/amortization and investment expenses; gross investment interest is a narrower different-basis measure.

children.label: Afudc earnings views
children.classification_note: AFUDC total earnings additions comprise equity and/or borrowed-fund components. Equity AFUDC is included in the total and does not represent cash interest received; capitalized borrowing interest is reconciled separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionAdditions
concepts.review_reason: Total AFUDC earnings additions may include equity and/or borrowed funds; equity AFUDC and capitalized interest overlap those components and are not extra additions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionCapitalizedCostOfEquity
concepts.review_reason: Equity AFUDC is only the assumed equity-return component of the broader AFUDC earnings addition; it must not be added to that total.

children.label: Equity method earnings
children.classification_note: Proportionate equity-method earnings differ from consolidated NCI attribution and investment disposal/impairment; issuer pretax subtotals determine inclusion.

children.label: Income loss from equity method investments
Nonservice pension cost
children.classification_note: This expense/reversal excludes service cost and includes nonservice pension components; it is not debt interest or total employee benefit expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetPeriodicDefinedBenefitsExpenseReversalOfExpenseExcludingServiceCostComponent
concepts.review_reason: Nonservice defined-benefit expense excludes service cost and contains interest and other pension components; it differs from debt interest and full employee benefit expense.

nodes.label: Interest measures with unresolved activity
nodes.classification_note: These interest measures do not establish nonoperating classification from their names alone. Instrument and maturity categories overlap. Operating net interest has an explicit operating definition and remains distinct.

children.label: Gross interest expense and components
children.classification_note: All-classification interest can include debt interest, short/long-term debt interest and other interest. These are aggregate and overlapping component views, not a list to sum.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpense
concepts.review_reason: Interest expense includes operating and nonoperating classifications; it overlaps the narrower financing and debt-interest measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebt
concepts.review_reason: Debt interest can be included in broader interest expense and nonoperating interest-and-debt expense; maturity-specific interest measures are narrower views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Long-term debt interest is a maturity-specific portion of debt interest, not an additional charge alongside total debt interest.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseShortTermBorrowings
concepts.review_reason: Short-term borrowing interest is a maturity-specific portion of broader debt interest; separate it only where the issuer excludes it from other instrument balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseOther
concepts.review_reason: Other interest expense is a residual that can be included in total interest expense or interest-and-debt expense; identify exclusions from instrument-specific interest.

children.label: Operating net interest
children.classification_note: The official definition explicitly classifies this interest net amount as operating; do not equate it to nonoperating interest net.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet
concepts.review_reason: The official definition explicitly identifies operating net interest, so this must not be mapped to nonoperating financing net interest.

children.label: Other interest income
children.classification_note: The other-interest asset category does not establish operating/nonoperating classification or exclusion from investment interest.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeOther
concepts.review_reason: Other interest income is an asset-category residual and can overlap investment interest or the net interest measures; operating classification is not specified.

nodes.label: Gains losses and separate presentation candidates
nodes.classification_note: These earnings and expense disclosures require issuer evidence of operating/nonoperating placement and whether separately presented. They may already be in reported expense or earnings lines; no unusual or exceptional subtotal is created.

children.label: Impairment measure views
children.classification_note: Broad impairment can include goodwill, long-lived and other asset impairment. Equity-method impairment has a distinct investment scope. These charges must not be added to inclusive impairment or cost aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Asset impairment charges include tangible assets, intangibles and goodwill and can contain the separate goodwill and held-for-use impairment measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill impairment is part of broad asset impairment and differs from held-for-use long-lived-asset impairment; do not add it to an inclusive impairment total.

children.label: Impairment of long lived assets held for use

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-use impairment includes long-lived assets to be disposed of other than by sale and overlaps broad impairment measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Other long-lived-asset impairment excludes goodwill and can overlap held-for-use impairment and broader asset impairment charges.

children.label: Equity method investment other than temporary impairment

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanTemporaryImpairment
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method other-than-temporary impairment can be embedded in investee income or broader impairment disclosures; determine issuer line and avoid a duplicate charge.

children.label: Disposal and combined asset gain loss views
children.classification_note: Business sale, disposal-group and equity-method disposal gains can overlap. Combined asset-sale/impairment gain-loss includes both sale effects and asset write-downs; no sum with narrower measures.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of business

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness
concepts.review_reason: Business disposal gains can include disposal groups or equity investments reflected in narrower sale measures; issuer operating/nonoperating and discontinued scope must be established.

children.label: Disposal group not discontinued operation gain loss on disposal

concepts.name: us-gaap:DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: This disposal gain/loss explicitly excludes discontinued operations; operating versus nonoperating placement still requires issuer presentation.

children.label: Equity method investment realized gain loss on disposal

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: Disposal gains on equity-method investments differ from recurring equity-method earnings and can overlap broader business-sale gains.

children.label: Asset sales and impairment net gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: This combined asset-sale and impairment gain/loss can contain separately reported impairment and disposal measures; do not combine it with those narrower views.

children.label: Investment unrealized gain loss views
children.classification_note: All-investment and marketable-security unrealized gains overlap; retain as review candidates until earnings versus OCI destination is verified.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized investment gains/losses can contain the marketable-security unrealized measure; confirm earnings versus OCI treatment and exclude OCI-only facts from the income statement.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecuritiesUnrealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized gains/losses on marketable securities are narrower than all-investment unrealized gains; issuer earnings versus OCI destination requires verification.

children.label: Derivative currency and warrant earnings
children.classification_note: Derivative, foreign-currency and warrant-liability remeasurement earnings can be included in fuel, purchasing, financing or residual earnings lines; issuer presentation determines line placement.

children.label: Gain loss on derivative instruments net pretax

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax
concepts.review_reason: Derivative gains/losses are net pretax earnings across all instruments; they may already be included in fuel, purchased power or other reported earnings lines.

children.label: Foreign currency transaction gain loss before tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBeforeTax
concepts.review_reason: Foreign-currency transaction gains/losses include realized and unrealized amounts in earnings; issuer operating/nonoperating placement is unresolved.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants
concepts.review_reason: Warrant fair-value adjustment is expense/income on a warrant liability, not an adjustment to EPS share counts; issuer earnings classification requires review.

children.label: Debt extinguishment earnings
children.classification_note: Debt extinguishment gain/loss is an earnings effect, not repayment principal or ordinary interest; confirm inclusion in interest/debt or other expense.

children.label: Gains losses on extinguishment of debt
Litigation and contingency earnings
children.classification_note: Settlement gains/losses and current contingency loss/reversal can overlap; a period expense does not equal an ending liability.

children.label: Gain loss related to litigation settlement

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettlement
concepts.review_reason: Litigation and insurance-claim settlement gains/losses can be operating or nonoperating and can overlap loss-contingency expense; no unusual-item subtotal is inferred.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LossContingencyLossInPeriod
concepts.review_reason: Current-period contingency loss/reversal includes estimate revisions and may overlap separately reported litigation settlements; it is not the ending contingency liability.

children.label: Acquisition and integration costs
children.classification_note: Acquisition transaction expense and post-combination integration expense have different scopes but can be included in administrative or other operating costs already reported.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts
concepts.review_reason: Acquisition-related costs exclude integration costs but can already be expensed within administrative or other operating cost; determine the issuer line.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationIntegrationRelatedCosts
concepts.review_reason: Integration costs exclude acquisition transaction costs and securities issuance costs but can contain employee, restructuring and administrative expense supplied elsewhere.

children.label: Other income with unresolved activity
children.classification_note: Other income can include operating and nonoperating amounts; do not force it into either section without issuer evidence.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherIncome
concepts.review_reason: OtherIncome has no operating/nonoperating restriction and can include amounts in narrower other operating or nonoperating categories.

nodes.label: Pretax continuing income views
nodes.classification_note: Consolidated pretax continuing income before versus after equity-method earnings are alternative subtotals. Domestic pretax income is a geographic component, not a consolidated alternative.

children.label: Pretax continuing income including equity earnings
Pretax continuing income before equity earnings

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesMinorityInterestAndIncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: This pretax continuing-income measure is before addition of equity-method earnings, unlike the supplied pretax measure including those earnings.

children.label: Geographic pretax components
children.classification_note: Domestic income can be contained in consolidated pretax continuing income; no foreign component is invented.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesDomestic
concepts.review_reason: Domestic pretax continuing income is a geographic component, not an alternative consolidated pretax total.

nodes.label: After tax continuing income views
nodes.classification_note: Continuing income including NCI, parent-attributable continuing income and NCI-attributable continuing income are different attribution views. They are not three independent amounts to add.

nodes.label: Discontinued operations
nodes.classification_note: Consolidated and parent-attributable discontinued income are different attribution scopes. Both are after tax and can include operating and disposal effects; the tax disclosure is not another deduction from those net amounts.

nodes.label: Net income attribution views
nodes.classification_note: ProfitLoss includes NCI while NetIncomeLoss is parent-attributable. NCI attribution can be contained in the consolidated amount; no arithmetic is implied by this group.

children.label: Net income loss attributable to noncontrolling interest

nodes.label: Common shareholder income and adjustments
nodes.classification_note: Basic and diluted common-shareholder income differ in assumed dilution. Preferred adjustments and participating-security allocations may already be reflected in reported numerators.

children.label: Common shareholder income views
children.classification_note: Basic and diluted common-shareholder earnings are numerator alternatives, not additional net income.

children.label: Preferred dividends and adjustments
children.classification_note: Preferred dividends are contained in the broader preferred-dividends-and-other-adjustments measure where reported; reconcile other numerator adjustments.

children.label: Preferred stock dividends income statement impact
Preferred stock dividends and other adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Preferred dividends and other adjustments include more than preferred dividends alone and can overlap other common-shareholder income adjustments; reconcile the EPS numerator.

children.label: Participating security allocation
children.classification_note: Two-class participating-security allocation is separate from preferred dividends and can already be deducted in common-shareholder earnings.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesBasic
concepts.review_reason: Participating-security allocation follows the two-class EPS method and is separate from preferred dividends; it may already be deducted in common-shareholder income.

nodes.label: Earnings per share
nodes.classification_note: All EPS measures are duration per-share facts. Total versus continuing and discontinued scopes are different; discontinued activity-only EPS differs from activity-plus-disposal EPS.

children.label: Total eps
children.classification_note: Basic and diluted EPS are different per-share calculations, not additive.

children.label: Continuing eps
children.classification_note: Continuing-operation EPS differs from total EPS; basic and diluted remain distinct.

children.label: Discontinued activity and disposal eps
children.classification_note: These after-tax EPS measures include day-to-day operations and disposal effects.

children.label: Discontinued operations and disposal EPS basic
Discontinued operations and disposal EPS diluted
Discontinued activity only eps
children.classification_note: These after-tax discontinued EPS measures cover day-to-day operations only and are not equivalent to the activity-plus-disposal measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationNetOfTaxPerBasicShare
concepts.review_reason: This basic discontinued EPS covers day-to-day operations only, unlike the discontinued EPS measure that also includes disposal gains/losses.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationNetOfTaxPerDilutedShare
concepts.review_reason: This diluted discontinued EPS covers day-to-day operations only and excludes the disposal component included in the broader discontinued EPS measure.

nodes.label: Weighted average shares
nodes.classification_note: Basic and diluted denominators are weighted-average duration shares. Total dilutive adjustment and incremental share awards are already reflected in diluted shares where used; do not add all four values.

children.label: Weighted average number of shares outstanding basic
Weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding
Dilution components
children.classification_note: Share-based incremental dilution is a subset of total dilutive potential shares; neither is a standalone EPS denominator.

concepts.name: us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberDilutedSharesOutstandingAdjustment
concepts.review_reason: Total dilutive potential shares is a denominator adjustment, not the diluted denominator itself; it can include incremental share-based award dilution.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToShareBasedPaymentArrangements
concepts.review_reason: Incremental shares from share-based awards are a subset of diluted-share adjustments already included in the diluted EPS denominator.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Financing capitalization and liability reconciliations are preserved outside primary reported earnings components; duration monetary does not necessarily mean an income-statement charge.

children.label: Interest cost capitalization reconciliation
children.classification_note: Interest incurred contains capitalized and expensed portions; capitalized-interest adjustment is not an extra expense. Borrowed-fund AFUDC can overlap this capitalization; no reconciliation is calculated without matched issuer facts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestCostsIncurred
concepts.review_reason: Interest incurred includes both capitalized and expensed costs and must not be treated wholly as the income-statement interest charge.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalizedAdjustment
concepts.review_reason: Capitalized interest is an adjusting item to interest incurred, not a separate current-period financing expense or an extra AFUDC earnings addition.

children.label: Contingent consideration reconciliation
children.classification_note: Liability movement can contain settlement or other non-earnings effects and must be reconciled before selecting an income-statement component.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationLiability1
concepts.review_reason: The change in contingent-consideration liability includes settlement differences and does not establish that the full liability movement is an earnings charge; retain as a supplementary reconciliation candidate.
